caption:
Large Sahab's Field Guide, No. 02: Friday Night Species. 🥃

Five more creatures, spotted in the wild this weekend. Only one of them is protected.

Which species are you? Be honest. Then tag the one in your gang.

And if you're the Cab Captain, Large Sahab salutes you. Never drink and drive.

#LargeSahab #EkLarge #FridayNight #DesiHumour

scenes.label: SPECIMEN No. 01
scenes.title: The Selfie Sommelier.
scenes.body: Photographs every glass. Has not taken a sip since 9 pm.

scenes.label: SPECIMEN No. 02
scenes.title: The Bill Vanisher.
scenes.body: Here all night. Gone to the washroom the moment the bill arrives.

scenes.label: SPECIMEN No. 03
scenes.title: The Story Repeater.
scenes.body: “Maine tumhe bataya tha na…” Yes. Three times tonight.

scenes.label: SPECIMEN No. 04
scenes.title: The Hug Distributor.
scenes.body: Peg three. Loves everyone. Even the bouncer.

scenes.label: SPECIMEN No. 05
scenes.title: The Cab Captain.
scenes.body: Books everyone's ride home. Waits till the last one is in.
